name: subscribe
description: Ask the mod to read a set of device values every interval_s game seconds and push an update event when a value other than the clock differs from the last reading (topic devices, the default), or to be told when a world finishes loading and when the game state changes (topic world, no other params), or of every held-tick job that ends, whichever client started it (topic jobs, no other params: a job_ended event with the job's id, tool, status, error and what it built and removed). id, logic, reads, gateway and include are read logic's; every read is answered one row per thing (read logic's items form), and one subscription holds what one such read may (128 things, 1,024 values). The reply carries the subscription id and the first reading. A subscription over a limit is refused with subscription_limit: poll with read logic at the same interval instead. Subscriptions end with the connection (or, with a resume token, when its window passes without a resume), on unsubscribe, or with a subscription_ended event (world_changed, revoked, limit, read_failed).

topic.description: devices (the default): device reads; world: world_changed and game_state events; jobs: job_ended events.

reads.description: read logic's reads: each {id, logic, slots, atmosphere, reagents}.

gateway.description: read logic's gateway: a gateway's id, or world.

include.description: clock: the game clock in each reading.

interval_s.description: Game seconds between reads; default 1. A paused game reads nothing.
